fact: A digital national database on birth registration was established with data units in county hospitals and service centres, but it is not yet fully implemented for real-time monitoring because of power and network limits; 66% of under-fives were registered in the 2019 DHS.
title: Multi-country Formative Evaluation of the Key Result for Children (KRC) #7 (Birth Registration) for the period 2018-2021 - Final Report Liberia
